scope: Independent public B, step 10 historical transmission; no household A/C or forecasts
design_timing: Declared before computing cycle results and correlations; sources and coverage already inspected
sensitivity_series: all 19 previously frozen ZHVI series; missing endpoints stay missing
lag_interpretation: corr(mortgage monthly percentage-point change at t, one-month log price change at t+lag), both dates inside named window; 0/1/2 closing timing, 6/12 exploratory longer transmission
identification: descriptive only; no causal price elasticity, no pooled-city independent shock count, no p-values or selected best lag
frequency: arithmetic mean of nonmissing weekly/daily observations dated in each complete calendar month; quarterly HPI separately compared at same quarter in 2021/2023/2026
buying_power: 30-year fully amortizing principal and interest only; constant payment; initial price index 100; fixed downpayment percent versus fixed downpayment dollars
housing_quality: ZHVI modeled smoothed seasonally adjusted index; bedroom count is not no-common-wall or strict repeated identical-property quality control
exclusions: 2026-10 incomplete month excluded from monthly joins; latest weekly rate separately displayed; no imputation; no pending-stock-to-sales-flow substitution
